title: Usability Principles
summary: Usability is task effectiveness, efficiency and satisfaction in context; heuristics diagnose risk but do not replace user testing.

MUST.text: Define task success and critical errors before evaluation.
Assess learnability, efficiency, error prevention, recovery and accessibility separately.
Report severity with impact, evidence and recovery cost.

SHOULD.text: Use Nielsen heuristics as an inspection lens, not a conformance checklist.

AVOID.text: Declare a design usable because it uses a component library.
Average away a blocker on a critical task.

FAILURE_MODES: Averaging away a blocker on a critical task hides release risk.
Declaring usability from a component library ignores task evidence.
Heuristic findings without severity and recovery cost cannot be prioritized.
